pages.text: A snail tank stood on one side of the classroom. A snail slowly crawled up the glass.
Lala wanted to hold the snail. But Lala's hands curled closed by themselves.
Mio placed the snail on a palm. It crawled smoothly along.
Lala's turn came. Lala hid both hands behind their back.
The snail crossed Bobo's hand and moved to Gaga's. Only Lala stepped back.
The snail returned to a leaf in its tank. Everyone's turn was over.
Lala stood alone before the tank. Those palms were damp with sweat.
Teacher Bau gently opened Lala's hand. "The snail can climb on when you open your hand."
Lala spread a palm wide. Teacher Bau gently placed the snail on it.
The snail slid across Lala's palm. Tickled, Lala laughed aloud. That palm stayed wide open.
